element.description: The element the session belongs to

value.description: The picked choice id in a one-entry array, as multiple-choice stores it.

choiceId.description:
Where older sessions hold the pick; read, never written.

Deprecated: Sessions hold the pick in `value`.

audioStartTime.description: When the first playback of the audio started (epoch milliseconds)

audioEndTime.description: When the first playback of the audio ended (epoch milliseconds)

shuffledValues.description: The choice ids in the order a student saw them when `lockChoiceOrder` is `false`

data.description: Where some sessions hold `shuffledValues`; read in preference to the root key
